up: Retrieve the exact activity values and chemical structures for compounds tested in assay CHEMBL4649968. Include the ChEMBL ID of the compound, the activity standard value, the standard units, the standard relation, and the canonical SMILES. Only return records where the standard relation is '=' (exact values).
sql:
SELECT
  md.chembl_id AS molecule_chembl_id,
  a.standard_value,
  a.standard_units,
  a.standard_relation,
  cs.canonical_smiles
FROM activities a
JOIN molecule_dictionary md ON a.molregno = md.molregno
JOIN compound_structures cs ON md.molregno = cs.molregno
JOIN assays ass ON a.assay_id = ass.assay_id
WHERE
  ass.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL4649968'
  AND a.standard_relation = '=';
